title: OpenAI says GPT-6 models can design new protein shapes and sequences using only reasoning and code, without calling specialized biology models to generate them (OpenAI)
summary: OpenAI: OpenAI says GPT-6 models can design new protein shapes and sequences using only reasoning and code, without calling specialized biology models to generate them — - Our GPT-6 family of models can design new protein shapes and the sequence of their chemical building blocks using only reasoning and code …
